==Description==
The '''Toy Soldier''' was an enemy that exclusively appeared in [[Cold Ambush]] as part of the [[Violent Night Event]]. It only appeared naturally on Wave ???/❄️, but was spawned earlier by the [[Builder Elf (Cold Ambush)|Builder Elf]] on Wave 19. It had an above average speed and a mediocre amount of health for its debut.

==Appearance==
The '''Toy Soldier''' was a toy that had a vibrant yellow skin tone. It was a wooden figure with a spherical head.  On its head was a red hat with a yellow stripe. It wore a red shirt, had yellow plates on its shoulders and wore a black bandolier on its torso. It also had dark maroon pants with black shoes.

==Strategy==
*High DPS towers like the [[Minigunner]], [[Accelerator]] or [[Engineer]] can take care of the '''Toy Soldier''' with relative ease.
**They can eventually become too much for these towers due to the ??? wave's health growth, so it is advised to eventually buy the plot after a few minutes.
**The [[DJ Booth]] and [[Commander]] can be useful in boosting the range and firerate of your towers to keep up with this enemy.
***The [[DJ Booth]] can also be helpful by increasing the range of your towers and decreasing their upgrade costs.
*As the [[Builder Elf (Cold Ambush)|Builder Elf]] spawns these in large groups, towers that can deal damage to multiple enemies, such as the [[Executioner]] or [[Engineer]], may need to be used to keep this enemy from becoming a threat.
